title: Loading, failure and retry are screens, not accidents
note: Waiting shows progress, a failure shows what happened, and a retry brings the data back.
intent: Anything that takes time or can fail needs three visible states besides success: waiting (a skeleton or spinner in the place the data will land, so the layout does not jump), failure (a sentence saying what happened and a Retry button), and recovery (the retry works and the screen continues from where it was). Disable a button while its action runs so a double click cannot send twice, and say so on the button ("Saving…"). Declare a demo named `failure-recovers` that makes the next load fail, shows the failure, retries and returns whether the failure was shown and whether the data came back.

check.name: failure-recovers
check.note: The demo `failure-recovers` fails a load on purpose, shows the failure and recovers on retry: result.errorShown and result.recovered are both true.

port: Data access goes through one `load(key)` that exposes pending/error/data; tests flip a failure flag in it, so the demo needs no network.
